title: FLUX.1-schnell: image to image from the all-in-one checkpoint
description: Prompt-guided image to image with FLUX.1-schnell from Comfy-Org's all-in-one checkpoint: the source image is encoded with the checkpoint's VAE and sampled again at a denoise below 1 (4 steps, CFG 1.0, euler, simple), so the prompt reshapes the image while lower denoise keeps more of its structure. Schnell doesn't follow edit instructions; it renders the prompt starting from the source. The output has the source image's size, rounded down to multiples of 8 by the VAE encode; the contract check refuses a source whose sides aren't multiples of 8. Denoise has no default: the caller chooses it. The checkpoint has to be in checkpoints/ (GAPS Q13).

slots.label: Source image (file name in ComfyUI's input folder)
Denoise (below 1 keeps more of the source)

evidence.note: The image-to-image pattern: LoadImage, VAEEncode into KSampler's latent, denoise 0.5 to 0.8 (lower is closer to the input). The skill gives no single value, so the recipe has no default.

evidence.source: ComfyUI workflow template flux_schnell (comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.103, GET http://127.0.0.1:8188/templates/flux_schnell.json, sha256 912fe178607a2c0e1ff12688703d22b34866949c9669ecc2739d19971e916b96)
evidence.note: Loader and sampler as in the template: CheckpointLoaderSimple flux1-schnell-fp8.safetensors (MODEL 0, CLIP 1, VAE 2), positive and empty negative CLIPTextEncode, KSampler 4 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple, VAEDecode with the checkpoint's VAE. The template is text to image; the source image path replaces its EmptySD3LatentImage.
